title: scene.state (relay → viewer)
description: Merged per-session state since the cached snapshot (docs/protocol.md §8.3): visual properties and removed ids only, never names. Always sent right after viewer.joined — as {nodes: [], removed: []} when nothing accumulated and snapshotVersion: null while no snapshot exists —, after scene.snapshot.ready and in reply to scene.request.

sceneVersion.description: Last accepted scene version; 0 while nothing was published (§8.3, §8.4).

snapshotVersion.description: Version of the cached GLB this state applies to, or null while no snapshot exists (§8.3).

nodes.description: Merged changes per node, in no particular order; empty when nothing accumulated.

removed.description: Ids removed since the snapshot; empty when none.
